messages:
elly: PR #2490 - migration guide 'Dedicated -> Private' with updated SDK snippets is ready for review. Preview: https://preview.redwood-inference.com/pr-2490. Assigning @tim for the tech check and @kevin for style. Heads up: docs CI reported linkcheck + vale errors on the preview so hold on merging.

ci-bot: CI results for PR #2490  failed checks: linkcheck, vale. To restart checks, comment `/retest`.

elly: Copying failing output for triage:
```
LINKCHECK FAIL: /docs/migration/dedicated-to-private.md -> broken anchor: https://docs.redwood-inference.com/migration/dedicated-to-private#networking-config (anchor not found)
VALE FAIL: docs/migration/dedicated-to-private.md:120  VALE[Grammar] 'utilise' flagged; prefer 'use' per style guide
```

tim: I can take the anchor. Looks like the section header was renamed in the target doc. Safer to add a short Networking snippet in this PR and point to the KB instead of relying on the anchor. I'll push the snippet.

kevin: I'll fix the Vale grammar and do a quick pass for tone. Also noticed a trailing-space markdownlint hint in the SDK code fence that might show up if we get markdownlint later.

elly: If you push fixes, will the docs preview rebuild automatically or do we need to `/retest`?

docs-bot: Pull request updated  new commit 9b3f1e0 pushed by tim. Docs preview rebuild queued: https://preview.redwood-inference.com/pr-2490

ci-bot: Docs preview completed  linkcheck PASS, markdownlint FAIL (1), vale FAIL (1)

kevin: markdownlint issue is trailing spaces in the SDK block, I trimmed them and replaced 'utilise' -> 'use' in two spots. Pushing a small commit now.

docs-bot: Pull request updated  new commit b4a2d8c pushed by kevin. Docs preview: build passed  all checks green.

elly: All green on the preview. Plan: merge during 14:30 PT docs merge window unless anyone objects. Please add the KB link to the PR description for support reference.

tim: Tech LGTM  snippets unmodified functionally. :+1:

kevin: Style LGTM  tiny wording changes only. :shipit:

elly: Thanks. Scheduling squash-merge at 14:30 PT.

docs-bot: PR #2490 merged by elly (squash). Change summary: docs(migration): add Dedicated->Private migration guide with SDK examples. KB cross-ref: https://kb.redwood-inference.com/migration/dedicated-to-private

elly: Follow-up: I updated the internal KB with the networking snippet and notified Support. Closing the loop here. End thread.
